nodes.summary: If a first-order language $L$ has no function symbols and finitely many relation symbols, there are finitely many $L$-structures on any finite set: a structure is determined by one relation $R^M \subseteq M^k$ for each relation symbol $R$ of arity $k$.
nodes.title: Finitely many structures on a finite set

nodes.summary: If a first-order language has no function symbols, every type carries an $L$-structure, for instance the one interpreting every relation symbol as the empty relation.
nodes.title: Relational languages have structures on every type

nodes.summary: For a relational language with finitely many symbols, $\mu_n(\neg\varphi) = 1 - \mu_n(\varphi)$ for every sentence $\varphi$ and every $n$. In particular $\mu_n(\varphi) \to 0$ iff $\mu_n(\neg\varphi) \to 1$.
nodes.title: Proportion for a negated sentence

nodes.title: Proportion of labelled structures satisfying a sentence

nodes.summary: Let $L$ be a first-order language with no function or constant symbols, finitely many relation symbols, and no relation symbol of arity $0$. For every first-order sentence $\varphi$ over $L$ (with equality), the proportion $\mu_n(\varphi)$ of $L$-structures on $\{1, \dots, n\}$ that satisfy $\varphi$ converges, and its limit is $0$ or $1$.
nodes.title: Zero-one law for first-order logic

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
